content: bgfx (bkaradzic/bgfx) is BSD-2-Clause. Supports headless context when native window handle (nwh) is NULL, but this is documented primarily for GL/D3D; Vulkan-backend headless surface handling has had rough edges historically (issue #1226, native window requirement for VkSurfaceKHR creation). It is a full cross-API rendering abstraction (GL/D3D/Metal/Vulkan) oriented around draw-call submission, not a thin Vulkan-only wrapper -- heavier abstraction than needed for a single schema-driven offscreen pipeline.
